Question:
If a small sphere is removed from a large sphere, how should the remaining volume be calculated?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h107_q4_question_en.svg)

Choices.B: Calculate only the volume of the small sphere
Choices.C: Take the difference between the surface areas
Choices.D: Subtract the volume of the small sphere from the volume of the large sphere

Solution: Removing a part means taking a difference, not adding.
